text_block_list.text:
Tour groups pouring out of multiple buses one after another.
I rushed over to the Yukoma Inn to help the two of them welcome all their guests――

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
A large tour group packing Yukoma Ryokan to maximum capacity.
Ufufu, this really gets my chef's spirit fired up~!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you today too.
We're expecting you to be a real asset to the team.

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Excuuuse me!
Is the banquet hall that way?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, we still have some time.
Until then, please relax and make yourself at home in your room.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
...Umm, I need to start plating
the food soon.
Phew, busy, busy!

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Proprietress!
I found some lost property in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, .
I'll look after that for you.

text_block_list.name: Delivery Person
text_block_list.text:
――!
Carrot Express delivery~.
Please sign for the package~!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, good work.
Please take me to the usual spot.

Left and right, the proprietress and apprentice proprietresses dashed about.
Their feet never stopping—

text_block_list.name: Troubled-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Umm, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Troubled-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um... I heard you could recuperate in hot springs...
But I don't really know about the different baths or what order to go in...

text_block_list.name: Troubled-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I stepped on something hard, and my hoof is inflamed...
What's the most effective course of treatment...?

I know how to treat this injury.
However, when it comes to the most effective way to bathe in hot springs, the landlady would know best.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha.
Just do what you think is right.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: That's all I can tell you.

...She walked off.
Unable to leave the remaining Umamusume alone, I rack my brain desperately.

She said she stepped on something hard.
For internal bleeding, you cool it at first, then apply heat once the swelling subsides, but...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
One cause of injuries is posture, you see.
Like muscle habits. After thoroughly warming and loosening them up, you slowly correct them.

text_block_list.name: Troubled-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, actually... never mind...
I'm sorry, when you're so busy...

text_block_list.name: Troubled-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh?

...The proprietress might suggest another way.
Yet this is the best course of action I could come up with on my own.
choice_data_list: (I just have to believe in myself and give it a shot...!)

text_block_list.name: Troubled-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible.
My body is moving with so much more range than usual!

text_block_list.name: Troubled-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I was told I had a bad habit in how I use my body.
But I didn't know how to fix it, so... I just left it like that all this time...

text_block_list.name: Troubled-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So I really had to loosen things up right from the root, huh.
Hehe, thank you so much, really……!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, looks like you handled it well.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I?
Do what you believe is right.
choice_data_list: ...Why did you say that to me?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Because I figured I could pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
You are a Trainer who has dedicated serious effort
to studying the recuperation of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Even this time, it was the result of making full use of all the knowledge you possess, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: However, my ability might not live up to your expectations...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Being too humble turns into self-deprecation, you know.
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with doing things
the way you want to.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Because you've got me by your side.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: As long as my eyes are on you, you are free to make mistakes to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Do as you please.
For now, you are granted that freedom!

—I felt it was the most reassuring smile in the world.
Not a promise that I'd never fall,
but that someone would be there to lift me up if I did.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter?
You're beaming so happily.

...While this person is watching over me,
I should try all kinds of things.
That was the realization this incident brought.
